hero.title: Your Image on a <accent>Custom</accent> Phone Case
hero.description: Capture your favorite memories with your own <emphasis>one-of-a-kind</emphasis> phone case. CaseMaker lets you protect your memories, not just your phone.

jonathan.name: Jonathan
jonathan.quote: “The case feels durable and I even got a compliment on the design. I've had the case for two and a half months now and <accent>the image is super clear</accent>. On the case I had before, the image started turning yellow after a couple of weeks. Love it.”

josh.name: Josh
josh.quote: “I usually keep my phone and keys together in my pocket, so all my previous cases got pretty scratched up. Aside from a barely noticeable scratch on the corner, this one <accent>looks brand new after about half a year</accent>. I dig it.”
